overall_summary: Analysis of historical performance shows that content centered around husband-wife relationship dynamics (e.g., 'Shaadi Ke Baad Pyaar Kahan Chala Gaya?' with 1770 views and 'पत्नी की ये बात हर पति को समझनी चाहिए' with 1679 views) significantly outperforms broad shayari, family bonds, or generic emotional shorts. Topics exploring modern relationship realities and compromises generate higher engagement.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos focusing on married life friction and understanding between partners achieved peak views (1600-1700+ views compared to 20-300 views for other categories).
winning_patterns.action: Double down on married life realities, unsaid expectations, and emotional distance after marriage.

weak_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'जिस दिन सच लिखूंगा… रिश्तों को षड्यंत्र लिखूंगा' received only 21 views.
weak_patterns.action: Avoid abstract, overly poetic, or cryptic shayari titles; ground content in concrete real-life observations.
